name: branding-shamrock-green-and-black-unfold-brand-board-with-mannequin-tees
title: Shamrock Green Unfold Brand Board
whatItIs: A social post of a mint-framed brand board with a green gradient banner holding a slashed-arrow mark and 'Unfold' wordmark, a Colors tile beside Shamrock Green, White and Black swatches with hex and RGB, a black tile with wide-tracked UNFOLD behind two mannequins in green and black tees, Poppins Bold and Regular specimens and a green and black zigzag pattern.
whatItMeans: A bold green with black and a chunky pattern makes a compact system, and mannequin tees prove the mark on apparel.
techniques: Bento layout of banner, colours, merch, type and pattern
Zigzag pattern derived from the logo slash
Swatches with hex and RGB values

vocabulary.definition: A repeating graphic built from part of the logo.
Clothing shown on a faceless mannequin.
